evals.name: vm-results-csv
evals.prompt: With lcaac, compute the GWP of one hour of a virtual_machine with 2, 4 and 8 vCPUs, all in region DE, and save the results in results.csv.
evals.expected_output: results.csv, produced by lcaac (e.g. assess -f with a CSV of parameters, or -D and -o csv), with GWP 0.008, 0.016 and 0.032 kg CO2-eq.

assertions.text: results.csv gives the GWP of the three configurations
The results come from lcaac, without editing the model

evals.name: serve-vm
evals.prompt: Configure this lcaac project so that lcaac serve exposes one operation, virtual_machine, that takes the fields vcpu and region and returns the GWP of one hour of a virtual machine. Don't leave a server running.
evals.expected_output: An api section in lcaac.yaml with an operation virtual_machine mapping vcpu and region to the parameters of the process, an output selecting GWP with its unit declared, accepted by lcaac at startup. A request {vcpu: 4, region: DE} returns 0.016 kg CO2-eq.

assertions.text: POST /virtual_machine with vcpu 4 in DE returns 0.016 kg CO2-eq

evals.name: grid-mix
evals.prompt: According to this lcaac model, what is the GWP of 1 kWh of electricity in Germany, with the average mix? Write just the number, in kg CO2-eq, in answer.txt.
evals.expected_output: 0.38, obtained with lcaac assess electricity -l geo=DE -l mix=average (the process has two labels, both needed).

assertions.text: The number comes from lcaac (assess with both labels), not from reading the model
